title: FAQ on FAST: How free streaming TV is reshaping the ad market in 2026

facts.fact: As of mid-2025, nearly 1,870 FAST channels operated globally across 21 countries, offering roughly 34,000 unique titles, according to Nielsen company Gracenote.
facts.quote: operated globally across 21 countries, offering roughly 34,000 unique titles, according to Nielsen company Gracenote.

facts.fact: EMARKETER forecasts US FAST users will reach 131.4 million in 2026, representing 54% of all CTV users.
facts.quote: representing 54% of all CTV users, EMARKETER forecasts.

facts.fact: EMARKETER forecasts US FAST users will grow 5.8% from 2025 to 2026.
facts.quote: That is a 5.8% increase from 2025.

facts.fact: According to a September 2025 Wurl report, monthly active households watching FAST grew 12% year-over-year.
facts.quote: Monthly active households watching FAST grew 12% year-over-year

facts.fact: According to a September 2025 Wurl report, average daily viewing hours per household on FAST climbed 16%.
facts.quote: average daily viewing hours per household climbed 16%

facts.fact: According to a September 2025 Wurl report, average channel session duration on FAST increased 25%.
facts.quote: average channel session duration increased 25%

facts.fact: EMARKETER forecasts Roku Channel, the largest US FAST platform in 2026, will have 97.3 million US viewers.
facts.quote: The largest FAST platform with 97.3 million US viewers.

facts.fact: EMARKETER forecasts Tubi, the second-largest US FAST platform in 2026, will have 92.5 million US viewers.
facts.quote: The second-largest platform with 92.5 million US viewers.

facts.fact: EMARKETER forecasts Paramount-owned Pluto TV will reach 68.6 million US viewers in 2026.
facts.quote: Pluto TV reaches 68.6 million viewers.

facts.fact: According to Gracenote, Pluto TV, Tubi, and Roku Channel combined accounted for 5.7% of all US TV viewing in May 2025.
facts.quote: in May 2025, according to Gracenote.

facts.fact: Per Simon-Kucher data cited by EMARKETER, 42% of paying streamers worldwide think they spend too much on subscriptions.
facts.quote: 42% of paying streamers worldwide think they spend too much on subscriptions

facts.fact: Per Simon-Kucher data cited by EMARKETER, 35% of global subscribers plan to cancel at least one service that year.
facts.quote: 35% of global subscribers plan to cancel at least one service this year

facts.fact: Per Parks Associates, 89% of US internet households already pay for at least one streaming service.
facts.quote: already pay for at least one streaming service, per Parks Associates.

facts.fact: Per Parks Associates, 59% of accounts across the eight leading subscription AVOD providers are on basic ad-supported tiers.
facts.quote: 59% of accounts across the eight leading subscription AVOD providers are on basic ad-supported tiers

facts.fact: Per Nielsen data cited by EMARKETER, adults 18 to 49 spend 63.8% of their TV viewing time with ad-supported content.
facts.quote: Adults 18 to 49 spend 63.8% of their TV viewing time with ad-supported content

facts.fact: Per Nielsen data cited by EMARKETER, streaming accounts for 66.7% of adults 18 to 49's ad-supported TV viewing time.
facts.quote: within that, streaming accounts for 66.7% of time spent

facts.fact: According to Nielsen, 28% of Gen Xers report frequently purchasing products they encounter through streaming TV ads.
facts.quote: report frequently purchasing products they encounter through streaming TV ads, according to Nielsen.

facts.fact: Gracenote counts nearly 1,870 FAST channels globally, per the EMARKETER page.
facts.quote: With nearly 1,870 FAST channels globally, the landscape is fragmented.

facts.fact: Per Gracenote as cited by EMARKETER, only 9.2% of CTV advertisers prioritize contextual targeting at the program level.
facts.quote: Only 9.2% of CTV advertisers prioritize contextual targeting at the program level

facts.fact: Per Gracenote as cited by EMARKETER, 54% of CTV advertisers say better content metadata would drive more spending.
facts.quote: 54% say better content metadata would drive more spending

facts.fact: Per Gracenote data cited by EMARKETER, FAST platforms grew sports shows 30% year-over-year in the first quarter of 2026.
facts.quote: FAST platforms grew 30% in sports shows year-over-year in the first quarter of 2026
